description:
Render a full branded card composition — header, KPI strip, chart, and footer — and return it as an inline base64-encoded image.

Use this tool when: you need a production-grade dashboard layout with a header (title, subtitle, badge), KPI metric row, themed background, footer, or brand kit; you want to send the full /api/v1/render JSON body verbatim to Chart-Output.
Do NOT use this tool when: you only need a simple chart without branding → use render_chart instead; you need a link rather than inline bytes (or a PDF) → use render_card_url for full branded cards or render_chart_url for simple charts; you have natural-language data → use render_chart_ai instead.
Behavior: this tool makes a remote API call to Chart-Output and may consume render credits. The spec is sent once, exactly as you give it; nothing is rewritten or retried. Cards are always returned as PNG, even if you ask for svg. Free-plan images carry a small watermark.

IMPORTANT — start from an example spec: call get_chart_example("mrr-breakdown") (or list_chart_output_examples to browse all ids) and change values only. Do not hand-write the full spec from memory. Keep labels and every dataset's data the same length (a mismatch is not rejected by default; the chart renders with gaps).

Returns: an inline base64 image at the format and dimensions defined in the spec, plus a confirmation text string with dimensions and format.
Errors (the message is plain text and keeps the API's details): 400 — invalid spec; every failing field is listed with its path. 401 — API key missing or invalid. 402 — monthly allowance used up; do NOT retry, tell the user (the message has the reset date and an upgrade link). 403 — the plan does not include something you used (pdf, a size above the plan cap, a brand kit over the limit); do NOT retry the same request, tell the user. 404 — unknown brand slug (the message lists the available ones). 429 — rate-limited; wait for Retry-After. Network error — chart-output.com is unreachable or timed out. A 400 for a field such as theme means that exact field is wrong; fix it and call again.
Limitations: does not support returnUrl or format "pdf"; inline image only. For the full field reference see https://www.chart-output.com/docs/card-composition.
Example: render_card({ spec: { ...get_chart_example("mrr-breakdown"), header: { title: "Q1 Report" } } })

repair.description: Opt in to the API's own repair mode (sent as repair_mode). "safe" fixes harmless problems without losing data (sorts {x,y} points, normalises colors, applies a default palette) and reports each repair. "off" only checks and returns a precise error with a suggested fix; it is the only way to catch labels/data length mismatches. Leave unset for the normal behavior. Set "safe" when you are unsure about your data. If an error says a decision is needed, ask the user.

spec.description: Full POST /api/v1/render body. Start from get_chart_example and change values. Top-level fields: `type`, `data {labels, datasets}`, `options`, `width`/`height` (100–4000), `format`, `scale` (1–4), `header {eyebrow?, title?, subtitle?, badge? {text, backgroundColor?, color?, borderRadius?, position? "start"|"end"}, align? "left"|"center", logoUrl?, logoHeight?, logoAlign?}`, `legend {display?, position? "top"|"bottom", style? "square"|"line"|"circle", fontSize?, gap?}`, `kpiStrip [{label, value, color?}]` (max 12, value is a string), `footer {left?, right?, borderTop?}`, `theme {palette?, backgroundColor?, fontFamily?, fontSize?, gridColor?, mode? "light"|"dark", textPrimary?, textSecondary?}` (an object, never a string), `border {color, width}`, `borderRadius`, `backgroundColor`, `padding` ("email"|"slack"|"pdf"), `brand` (saved brand kit slug), `brandKitId` (preset name or UUID), `textScale` (1–2), `annotations`, `dataLabels` (true/false), `alt_text` (true or "ai"). The longest edge × scale must fit your plan: 1200 px on Free, 3000 px on Pro and Agency (the API answers 403 above that). Do not send `returnUrl`.

name: render_card
